objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions that undergoes creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (e.g. Level 2, Level 4).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifier (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time span for validity checks, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period after invalidation, default 10 years.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to related master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications associated with the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Organizational scopes where the document applies.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system can view the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document linked to a main document that follows the main document release cycle and triggers a new version of the main document upon creation, modification, or archiving.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Own version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status mirroring the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary non-critical information object linked to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal for modifying an existing released document, managed independently without affecting the document version until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggered when a document has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in one or more roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: License-based role assigned to the user (e.g. AUTHOR).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used for assigning read or change authorizations and distribution to documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group purpose (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that orchestrates approval steps such as creator sign-off, review, and release with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: The type of workflow process (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A configured list of user groups and individual persons who receive a document upon release, either by email notification or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Method of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A business unit or department within the organizational structure that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific view providing users with lists of relevant documents, status reports, and evaluation information.

attributes.name: dashboard_type
attributes.description: Type of dashboard view (e.g. Reader Document List, Author overview, Status report).

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation report providing filtered information about documents based on selected parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the report (e.g. Status Report Documents & Instruction, Document Monitoring, Acknowledgement Status).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is modified using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format and displayed on the web.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The author or co-author initiates the 3-step approval process (Creator, Review, Release) for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process using an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content according to technical and formal aspects and completes the task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, completing the task with an electronic signature, making the document visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing immediate cancellation of the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when revisions are needed, retaining all data from the previous version.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment object is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document without affecting the content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of the assigned change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser or release participants confirm the continued validity of a document, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document, starting the override workflow automatically.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group and starting the archive duration.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the document with retained metadata and restored authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Upon release of a new version, users on the distribution list are notified by email.

evts.name: distribute_document_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, users on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via workflow without signature.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is checked and released through a workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, or pending actions.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An attachment belongs to and is linked to a main document, sharing its release cycle.
Additional information is supplementary to a document without affecting its release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity needs to be checked.
An override request is created for a specific document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request references a specific invalidated document to be reactivated.
One or more templates are defined per document type and can be selected when creating documents.
A distribution list is maintained per document to define who receives the document upon release.
Documents can reference other documents through the References attribute or local extensions in multi-client systems.
Documents can be linked to organizational units in the system.
Users are assigned to user groups which grant them specific roles and authorizations.
User groups are assigned to distribution lists for document distribution.
Individual persons can be directly assigned to distribution lists.
